name: BANDAR Q
description: Bandar Q is a high-speed Indonesian gambling game played with a single set of 28 dominoes. It is a 'banking' game where one player acts as the 'Bandar' (Dealer) and others wager against them. The game's name comes from 'Kiu' (9), the highest possible hand value. Each participant is dealt two dominoes, and the goal is to have a pip total whose units digit is closer to 9 than the Banker's. Famous for its simple 'Modulo-10' math and rapid turnover, it is a staple of Southeast Asian social gambling.

content.text: Bandar Q is a high-speed Indonesian gambling game played with a single set of 28 dominoes. It is a 'banking' game where one player acts as the 'Bandar' (Dealer) and others wager against them. The game's name comes from 'Kiu' (9), the highest possible hand value. Each participant is dealt two dominoes, and the goal is to have a pip total whose units digit is closer to 9 than the Banker's. Famous for its simple 'Modulo-10' math and rapid turnover, it is a staple of Southeast Asian social gambling.

Originating in Indonesia as a simplified version of 'Qiu Qiu' (9-9). While Qiu Qiu uses four tiles and is closer to poker, Bandar Q was designed for faster banking action, similar to the western game of Baccarat but using dominoes instead of cards.
2-8 players. One is the 'Bandar' (Banker); others are 'Pemasang' (Bettors).
A standard double-six set of 28 dominoes (0-0 to 6-6).
After bets are placed, each player and the Banker receive 2 tiles face down.

items.text: Ceme: A variant where the Banker role is fixed and doesn't rotate frequently unless the player leaves.
Qiu Qiu: A 4-tile version with poker-style betting rounds.
